dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the visible posterior extremity.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth lateral margins; subtle localized convex bulge present on the left lateral margin mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform medium-slate grey median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, prominent, dark, longitudinal high-contrast disruption located along the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep, elongated longitudinal indentation along the central dorsal axis, characterized by significant shadow-casting within the crevice.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant longitudinal lesion or indentation along the dorsal ridge, centrally located on the visible posterior half of the body.
